Rich, saw Loop just launched Loop Intelligence, an AI engine trained on over 200M shoppers.

Shipping a flagship AI product usually means more in-market brands in play than your reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Loop off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Rich, quick follow-up for Loop.

With Loop Intelligence to sell into the base, the number tends to climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Loop needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rich, last bit of proof for Loop.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Loop's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth ecommerce software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
